acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of painting and finishing an addition in the East Bay area varies significantly based on factors like the size of the addition, the type of surfaces to be painted, the quality of materials selected, and the complexity of the job. For an accurate estimate, we recommend a consultation where we can assess your specific project requirements, discuss material options, and provide a detailed quote tailored to your budget and preferences. Prices for painting and finishing can range depending on these variables.
